newsitem.title: USA: Merrill Lynch leads brokerage, bank rally.
newsitem.headline: Merrill Lynch leads brokerage, bank rally.

text.p: Merrill Lynch & Co shares jumped nearly ten percent, leading a surge in financial and banking stocks in a rally that brought the Dow Industrials above 7,000 for the first time ever.
Shares rose 8-5/8 to 96-5/8 and hit a new high of 97 during intraday trading. The stocks was one of the highest gainers, on a percent basis, on the New York Stock Exchange.

The stock leapt after Goldman Sachs & Co said the stock was on its recommended list earlier in the day, according to a source. The gains came on the backs of a broader rally in financial and banking stocks.
Among other brokerage firms, Morgan Stanley Group Inc rose two to 68-7/8. A.G. Edwards Inc rose 1-3/8 to 39-1/8.
In banking, Citicorp rose 3-7/8/4 to 123-3/8, BankAmerica shares added 5-1/8 to 123 and J.P. Morgan & Co rose 2-3/4 to 106-3/4.
All five stocks hit new year highs.
